summary_en: BCJ-110 amended its tender offer for eSOL ordinary shares following a September 10, 2026 agreement with major shareholder Aval Data to tender all its eSOL holdings. The revised disclosure reflects this shareholder commitment without changing the offer price or other core terms.
title_en: Notice regarding amendment to the announcement on commencement of tender offer for ordinary shares of eSOL Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 4420) by BCJ-110 Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief: On September 11, 2026, BCJ-110 Co., Ltd. submitted an amended tender offer filing to the Kanto Finance Bureau regarding its tender offer for ordinary shares of eSOL Co., Ltd., which commenced on September 2, 2026. The amendment was necessitated by a binding agreement executed on September 10, 2026 with Aval Data Co., Ltd., a major shareholder of eSOL, whereby Aval Data committed to tender all of its eSOL shares and irrevocably agreed not to withdraw such tender. This change required an update to the public filing under Article 27-8(2) of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act. The company emphasizes that this amendment does not constitute a modification of tender conditions as defined in Article 27-3(2)(1) of the Act, meaning the core offer terms including price and timeline remain unchanged. The revised disclosure reflects only the updated status of shareholder commitments following Aval Data's agreement to participate in the tender offer.
